_note: Hand-authored vectors for packages/shared/src/algorithms/placementSweep.ts (TASK_WINDOW_REWORK slice 4a) ↔ Swift Helpers/PlacementSweep.swift. Mini shapes: tasks default type counting / isCompleted false / isDeleted false; boards default active 3×3 weekly over the fixed window; boardTasks default not deleted; events default kind increment / not deleted. `expected` is the whole plan (deep equal; arrays in planner order). Expected values were cross-checked by running the TS planner once during authoring.

planPlacementSweep.name: a derived counter placement repoints to its root with the frozen goal as the override (incomplete before and after)
a custom title on the derived row rides onto the placement as titleOverride; completion (5 ≥ 5) is preserved
a slice-3a targetOverride already on the placement wins over the row's frozen goal
refused: the board already places the root (one row per task per board) → marks stripped
refused: the root is deleted → marks stripped
refused: the re-derivation would change (goal-less derived row → the root's own goal 3 completes) → marks stripped
sealed board: the repoint takes the sealed path; events after sealedAt are bounded away on both sides; snapshot matches → no drift
sealed board whose stored snapshot already disagrees with the kernel: repointed, drift reported
orphans: an unplaced marked row with no live parent link is tombstoned; a placed one and a compound child are not; a row repointed this run retires next run
two boards: one repoints, one is refused for a duplicate — the shared row is NOT stripped because the first board repoints it
a deleted placement and a deleted board are ignored

rekeyIds.name: a collapse keeps the first occurrence
two derived rows of one root collapse to one

rekeyRecordKeys.name: ascending visit order: the FIRST key landing on a target wins
